title: Lone Beacon
commonMistakes: Using a hash map when the problem asks for constant extra space
Forgetting that the unique value can be zero or negative
Initializing the running value to the first element and then XORing it twice
Assuming the unique value is always positive
followUps: What if every value appears three times except one?
What if two values appear once and the rest appear twice?
How would you solve it without the XOR trick?
attribution: Problem statement, explanation, and solutions by the Base Case contributors. Example and test provenance is under audit.
